title: KEAM 2026 Examination
description: KEAM (Kerala Engineering Architecture Medical) is an annual entrance exam conducted by the CEE Kerala for admission to professional degree courses (Engineering, Pharmacy, Architecture, etc.) in Kerala. For 2026, the exam is a 100% computer-based test, with Engineering/Pharmacy held by CEE, while Architecture and Medical admissions use NATA/NEET scores, respectively, alongside mandatory KEAM registration.
